department: Faculty of Social Sciences — Department of Geography

deadline.value: Main Round application deadline is December 1, 2026 (HKT 23:59 GMT+8; HKPF deadline December 1, 2026 at noon HKT; clearing rounds April 30 and August 31, 2027).

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for environmental and geographical sciences (ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Department of Geography advises applicants to contact prospective advisors at their earliest convenience before applying.
supervisor.quote: *Please contact your prospective advisor at your earliest convenience

funding.value: Registered MPhil and PhD students are eligible to receive Postgraduate Scholarships (HK$19,135/month; HK$19,655/month after confirmation, wef 1/9/2026) and HKU-PS/HKPF fellowships, subject to funding availability.
funding.quote: Students registering for MPhil and PhD degrees are eligible to be selected to receive the Postgraduate Scholarship.

also.quote: The basic level of scholarship is HK$19,135 per month (wef 1/9/2026).

entry_route.value: Offers 3-year (post-research master's) and 4-year (post-honours bachelor's) PhD programmes.
entry_route.quote: the Department of Geography at The Universityt of Hong Kong offers research postgraduate programmes leading to Master of Philosophy (MPhil) (2-year) and Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) (3-year and 4-year) degrees

also.quote: All candidates with an honours Bachelor’s degree are eligible for PhD and MPhil admission.

notes: Covers physical geography, climate change, carbon sequestration, urban environment, and marine/remote sensing topics; Faculty of Science's Swire Institute of Marine Science (SWIMS) and Department of Earth and Planetary Sciences also offer environmental/marine PhD supervision.
